current.text: Josh projects Washington as the starting power forward. His projected Dallas starting five is Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
The Dallas frontcourt is crowded with forwards and bigs who expect minutes.
Dusty May is the new head coach. It is not known yet how he will split minutes among the centers and forwards like Washington.
Cooper Flagg is the first option on offense and Kyrie Irving is second. Kyrie's return is expected to take shots mostly from players other than Flagg.
Josh sees no path to a top 80 finish because Dallas has so many forwards. He ranks Washington around 125 to 150 in category leagues.
The experts disagree on drafting him. One mock draft calls him an upside pick at 161. Josh says he cannot see himself being interested in Washington at all.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoff weeks, which is probably the best in the league. It also has the league-high 16 back-to-backs.
Dallas does not own its draft pick, so it has no reason to tank.

durable.text: Washington is very streaky. He has hot shooting stretches and ice-cold slumps, and his shooting has been trending down lately.

note: Washington is a last-round player in our league at best. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 137), ESPN at 0.2 USD (rank 149), and he went for 1 USD in our auction last season. His projected 44.8% FG and 69.7% FT do not help any build, so take him only for 1 USD as a bench piece with rebounds and blocks, and lean toward the 4-4-4 playoff schedule if he is still rostered then. Early in the season, check whether Dusty May keeps him in the starting five and whether his shooting comes out of its slump. Otherwise leave him on waivers.
